en.headline: Hong Kong seals deals for local gold refineries to boost trading hub
en.dek: Agreements with Swiss and mainland firms will allow refining in the city, completing a full gold trading ecosystem as storage capacity targets expand.
body: Hong Kong has signed agreements that will see international and mainland gold refineries establish production facilities in the city, advancing plans to become a global gold trading hub.

The Office for Attracting Strategic Enterprises confirmed deals involving Switzerland-based Valcambi and Point Gold International. Officials said local refining will remove the need to rely solely on external processing and support the goal of expanding gold storage capacity beyond 2,000 tonnes within three years.

Financial Services and the Treasury Secretary Christopher Hui has been promoting the initiative, including recent visits to Swiss refiners. Analysts noted that combining Hong Kong’s financial infrastructure with physical refining capacity could strengthen the city’s position as a trusted vault and price-setting centre for the region.

zh.headline: 香港簽協議引入本地黃金精煉廠 推進交易中心
zh.dek: 與瑞士及內地公司達成協議，將在港設立精煉設施，完善黃金交易生態，並配合倉儲擴容目標。
body: 香港已簽署協議，引入國際及內地黃金精煉企業在本港設立生產設施，推動成為全球黃金交易樞紐的計劃。
招商引資辦公室確認與瑞士Valcambi及點金國際等達成安排。官員表示，本地精煉可減少對外加工依賴，並配合三年內將黃金倉儲容量擴至超過2000噸的目標。
財經事務及庫務局局長許正宇近期到訪瑞士煉廠推廣相關計劃。分析認為，結合香港金融基建與實體精煉能力，有助強化本港作為區域可信金庫及定價中心的地位。
